verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury's FinancialAccount object acts as a distinct money container separate from the payments balance, and platforms can create financial accounts with financial addresses (routing/account-style details) for connected accounts at scale via Connect, matching per-customer/sub-account provisioning under a master platform structure. Missing for 10: explicit documentation calling out 'unique routing and account numbers' terminology and independent/hands-on confirmation of scale reconciliation use, so some inference is required from 'financial address' language.
